snippet.title: Ghatika | Hand illustrated 2D side-scroller | Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Ghatika is a hand illustrated 2D side-scrolling action-adventure set in a fantasy world with ancient kingdoms, ruthless polity and mysterious tribes. Explore dense jungles, boulder fields and mountain ranges as you desperately try to secure the safety of your people. Strange events are afoot that seem to be tied to the complex history of your people. Fight off bandits and predators as you try to befriend the tribes and uncover the secrets of Ghatika. 

This is early-alpha gameplay showcase highlighting core systems and atmosphere. Visual polish, UI clarity, animation passes, and balancing are still in progress
